scope: Independently authored bounded native Bash hook for interrupted conversation resume
constraints: Standard library only, no proxy or prior implementation imports
Read only an owned expectation and the public native hook packet, never native transcripts, credentials or effect files
Exact native session, hook event, client tool, call ID and command checks; bounded optional display description
Only fixed receipts and owned PID/group/ID-digest records are written
Two-second input bound, thirty-second wait, signal exits with refusal; success requires the owned explicit release marker
No network, subprocess, client tool effect or arbitrary command execution
